text:
harper: heads-up — we saw a spike of 503s on project-omega this AM. looking at quota dashboard, org-wide projectless traffic pushed the org quota threshold and started throttling.

leo: wait, project-omega is separate. how did projectless traffic push the org quota? should be per-project buckets.

harper: the requests were from old CI SA tokens that lost x-origin-project header during streaming proxy GC. they still have sa_id so attribution service marked them as "projectless" and we apply org fallthrough quota. that pushes org-level counters.

indira: that matches an incident I saw last month. we shard quota by (project_id || fallback=org). when project_id missing we add to org bucket. bad for noisy tenants.

zane: ouch. users get throttled and think it's the project owner. also hard to surface in console since console only shows project quotas, not the "contributed by orphaned SAs" breakdown.

leo: short term can we change proxy to preserve x-origin-project for requests carrying sa_id? cheap guard.

harper: yes i can ship that patch. but longer term we need a principled attribution policy and console telemetry change.

indira: proposal: attribution service should tag fallback_attribution_source = "sa_last_known_project" if we can reconstruct, else "orphaned". then quota accounting should increment a separate "fallback_contrib" counter under org so we can alert.

zane: great — console change: show breakdown on org quotas: native project usage vs fallback_contrib (collapsed by SA). add a link from quota line -> list of impacted SAs with last_seen and owner contact.

leo: backend pseudo: 
```
if missing(x-origin-project):
  if sa_id and lookup(sa_id).last_known_project:
    attribution.project = lookup(sa_id).last_known_project
    attribution.fallback_source = "sa_last_known_project"
  else
    attribution.project = null
    attribution.fallback_source = "orphaned"
  end
  emit(metric.quota_contrib, {org, project=attribution.project, fallback_source})
end
```

indira: rollout plan: patch proxy -> canary 1% -> enable metric fallback_contrib (infra) -> add grafana panel and alert when fallback_contrib / org_total > 0.2 for 30m -> console beta showing SA list -> change default billing attribution after legal signs off.

harper: alert rule request: Alert when fallback_contrib ratio > 0.2 sustained for 30m AND > $1000 estimated cost. prevent noisy low-dollar blips.

zane: UX detail: when user clicks an SA in the impacted list, show "Reassign to project" and "Contact owner". reassign should require confirmation and show what quota/billing change will occur.

leo: also add a small flag in requests/traces: attribution.debug = fallback_source so debugging is obvious in traces.

ops-bot: deploy started: proxy-service v1.2.4 -> canary (3/26 14:12 UTC)

harper: i'll open a PR for the proxy guard and a follow-up for attribution tagging. assigning to indira for metrics and zane for console wireframes.

indira: will add grafana panel + alert. ping me if you want test queries.

zane: i'll mock the SA list UI and post screenshots in #design later today.

(leo reacts with :eyes:, indira reacts with :thumbsup:)
